title: Ge’ez Bible (Ethiopian and Eritrean canon)

editorialMarkers: Chapter and verse numbers follow the Ethiopian tradition and may differ from Hebrew, Greek or English editions; a book is present only where Beta maṣāḥǝft has an edition of it and that edition holds Ge’ez, so a work catalogued but not yet transcribed is absent rather than present and empty. Nine books are recorded one unit to the chapter rather than verse by verse — the Kebra Nagast among them — so a reference into those reaches a chapter. Where only part of a work is held, the name and the numbering say so rather than implying the whole: 3 Ezra begins at its eleventh chapter because its eleventh is where this text begins, and 2 Meqabyan is the first ten of its twenty-one. Word-level transliterations exist upstream and are not taken here. Nothing in this package is equated with a book of another canon except where the text itself is the same book. The provenance of each book, and the corrections made to three of them, are recorded in the project’s corpus register.
